label: preparing
what: A surprise jubilee gathering for the mayor, apparently marking forty years of service, at town hall on day 1 at 18:00: eight lanterns and 200 fresh loaves, with the mayor invited under a lighting-review pretext. The mayor learned of the discreet bread gathering and financing but was not told its confirmed celebratory purpose. Secretary assisted scheduling and debt oversight, but knowing assistance with the surprise itself is not established; neither neighbour nor watchman is established as a knowing helper.
